body: Inspect public missingness, robust local deviation, level continuity, and period-consistency evidence, and localize regions. Output at most two structured pattern_hypotheses, each with a canonical hypothesis_id, a pattern_type from missingness, extreme_deviation, level_excursion, period_inconsistency, regime_ambiguity, or no_actionable_signal, the region_fractions it covers, the evidence_features supporting it, and a confidence level. Preserve disjoint narrow hypotheses when a high robust-z signal spans a broad low-density region instead of merging the whole span. Keep competing mechanisms as separate hypotheses. Procedure marker: sparse_localization_subregions/v1.
